components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Tactile primary action button with 2px bottom lip and cobalt focus ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid #1e40af; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 100ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary framed button with 2px slate border shifting to cobalt on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: rgb(var(--fg, 15 23 42)); border: 2px solid rgb(var(--border, 226 232 240)); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.6); color: #2563eb; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card Container
components.description: Tactile 2px-bordered study surface container with 16px radius.
components.html:
Audio Dictation

Sentence-by-sentence listening drills with speed control.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 16px; border: 2px solid rgb(var(--border, 226 232 240)); background: rgb(var(--surface, 255 255 255)); color: rgb(var(--fg, 15 23 42)); padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05); transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.6); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 14px; color: rgb(var(--fg-muted, 71 85 105)); margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 40px rounded-xl input with 2px border and cobalt focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Type what you hear..." />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid rgb(var(--border, 226 232 240)); background: rgb(var(--surface, 255 255 255)); color: rgb(var(--fg, 15 23 42)); padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); }

narrative.overview:
LinguaCraft is built as a crisp, tactile academic study bench where learners spend extended sessions listening, typing dictation, shadowing phonetics, reviewing SM-2 flashcards, and taking timed IELTS/TOEIC simulations. Rather than heavy gradients or ornamental chrome, the interface relies on cool slate paper canvases, high-contrast ink typography, and deliberate 2px structural borders that separate active controls from surrounding study material.

Both the light workspace and the low-glare .dark theme are grounded in CSS custom properties in globals.css paired with Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes. Interactive affordances communicate state through crisp border shifts, subtle 1px bottom-lip compression on primary actions, and clear semantic feedback tones for accuracy, warnings, and PRO tier badges.
keyCharacteristics: Cool slate paper backgrounds (--bg, --surface, --surface-muted) paired with high-contrast slate ink (--fg, --fg-muted).
Single focused Cobalt Signal accent for primary CTAs, active navigation pills, and keyboard focus rings.
Tactile 2px structural borders on cards, inputs, and outline controls (border-2), plus a 2px bottom lip on raised primary/danger buttons.
Complete light (:root) and dark (.dark) theme parity across marketing and workspace shells.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt Signal drives primary actions, active route indicators, and focus rings; reserve Amber Crest strictly for PRO entitlements and warnings, and Emerald/Crimson strictly for pass/fail study feedback.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Parity Rule
rules.body: Every light-mode slate surface and border must define an explicit .dark counterpart so theme switching preserves >=4.5:1 body text contrast.

rules.name: The Weight-Over-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Separate headings from study copy through font weight (700–800 vs 400) and tight tracking rather than decorative fonts or gradient text.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat at rest using 2px structural borders and tonal step contrast; reserve heavy shadow-xl elevation strictly for drawers and modals.

dos: Do reuse Button, Card, Badge, Input, LoadingState, ErrorState, EmptyState, and DataPagination from src/shared/ui before creating local markup.
Do preserve <= 40px minimum control height (40px md / icon buttons, 44px+ mobile touch clearance) and visible focus-visible rings on every interactive element.
Do keep light (:root) and .dark contrast balanced whenever adding custom status surfaces or borders.
Do use EmptyState and ErrorState honestly when the backend API is unavailable or returns empty study sets.
donts: Don't invent webfont stacks or decorative serif headings that diverge from the zero-FOUT system sans stack.
Don't place heavy drop shadows (shadow-lg/shadow-xl) on static workspace cards—keep cards flat with 2px borders and shadow-sm.
Don't apply Amber PRO gradients to ordinary navigation or non-PRO controls.
Don't fabricate acoustic phoneme/prosody bars or official exam scores in UI copy when backend measurementTier is transcript-only.
